lines.en: I'm here. What do I have to do?
Um, I have you on phone answering duty from 4 to 6:00 a.m.
That's horrible. I have to nap up.
If I don't get a solid five, it kills my sunny disposition.
Run.
Run. Wake up.
Run, wake up. It's Leslie.
Ah! God!
Are you having a bad dream?
No, I suffer from a disorder called sleep fighting.
Wow, that must be terrible.
Only when I'm losing.
Look, I'm freaking out, okay?
Tom is not here, and he's got debt left ramp,
and I have three hours to fill.
I'm sure you'll figure something out.
Don't go back to sleep, okay? I need you to wake up.
Run. Come on. Help me.
Attaboy.
I am only here because I owe Leslie a thousand favors.
I'm not big on charities.
Give a man a fish, and you feed him for a day.
Don't teach a man to fish, and you feed yourself.
He's a grown man.
He's a grown man.
Fishing's not that hard.
